description: This file defines the 'Image' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace. The class represents an image object in a document, providing properties and methods for handling image attributes such as name, scale, aspect ratio, resolution, and formatting. It includes functionality for cloning, deep copying, serialization to DDL format, and retrieving file paths for images.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image within a document, with properties for image attributes and methods for serialization and cloning.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this Image object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, including cloning the PictureFormat if present.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Image object into DDL format for document serialization.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the effective file path of the image, considering stored image data, working directory, and configured image path.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets or sets the name or path of the image file.

properties.name: ScaleWidth
properties.description: Gets or sets the horizontal scaling factor of the image.

properties.name: ScaleHeight
properties.description: Gets or sets the vertical scaling factor of the image.

properties.name: LockAspectRatio
properties.description: Indicates whether to maintain the aspect ratio when scaling.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Gets or sets the picture format details.

properties.name: Resolution
properties.description: Gets or sets the image resolution in DPI.

properties.name: Interpolate
properties.description: Indicates whether image interpolation should be used.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Provides access to internal nullable property storage for image attributes.

classes.name: ImageValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for the Image class, including Name, ScaleWidth, ScaleHeight, LockAspectRatio, PictureFormat, Resolution, and Interpolate.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a new deep copy of the Image object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy, ensuring nested objects like PictureFormat are also cloned.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Image object into DDL format using a Serializer.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the image's file path based on the image name and document image path configurations.
